introduction: Delaware Energy Assistance Program helps eligible households with heating, cooling and energy emergencies. It supplements energy costs rather than paying every bill.
description: Delaware Energy Assistance Program helps eligible households with heating, cooling and energy emergencies. It supplements energy costs rather than paying every bill.

sections.who: Household income and the type of assistance determine eligibility. Renters and homeowners can apply for winter heating support.
sections.get: The state lists winter heating assistance from October 1 to March 31 and crisis help year-round. Summer support has separate conditions.
sections.docs:
• Household and income information.
  • Energy account or delivered-fuel details.
  • Any shutoff notice, overdue bill or low-fuel information.
sections.apply:
1. Apply or request an appointment

    Use ASSIST or the contacts on DHSS Utility Assistance.

  2. Contact the county partner

    Catholic Charities lists New Castle 302-654-9295, Kent 302-674-1782 and Sussex 302-856-6310.

  3. Explain the emergency

    Specify the shutoff date or remaining fuel and ask what immediate assessment is available.
sections.after: Keep paying what you can and speak with the energy supplier about arrangements. An application is not confirmation that disconnection is stopped.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DHSS energy assistance and intake. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is crisis assistance limited to winter?
Yes. Winter heating support serves renters and homeowners.
Will the program pay every energy expense?
Where do I ask about current intake?
Use the county partner contacts on the state page.
